description:
List all current seasonal offers and packages published on praegant.net.

Use when the guest asks about deals, packages or what is special in a season, independent of dates.
When the guest already has dates, check_availability includes only the offers valid for that stay — no
need to call both. Visual version: render_offers_card.
Behaviour: read-only; offers as published on the website (synced hourly, expired ones removed).
Returns text plus structuredContent.offers (title, valid_from, valid_to, price_text, summary, url).

language.description: Answer language: 'de' (default) or 'en' — use the language of the conversation. Text and card are always in the same language.
language.title: Language

name: get_offers

offers.description: title, valid_from, valid_to, price_text, summary, season, url, includes, image
